high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie outdoors. The individual is wearing a light gray, long-sleeved crop top that reveals their midriff and matching light gray sweatpants. They are also wearing beige platform shoes. In their left hand, they hold a black smartphone with a clear case, using it to take the photo. Their right hand holds a black mug with white text on it. The setting appears to be a backyard or patio area. There is a wooden fence in the background, and a tree with green leaves is visible behind it. String lights are strung across the scene, adding a decorative touch.
